name: Full happy path: upload, map, process, summary

planSteps.description: Navigate to the upload page: http://127.0.0.1:8501/upload

Set the file input to a file named 'sales.csv' whose UTF-8 content is exactly:
Order ID,Order Date,Customer Name,Region,Qty.,Revenue
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc,north,2,"$1,240.00"
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc,north,2,"$1,240.00"
ORD-2,2026-09-02,Beta Co,south,3,"€ 3.040,00"
ORD-3,31/09/2026,Gamma Ltd,north,4,not available
'Files ready to process' appears and lists 'sales.csv' with 4 rows.
Click the primary button 'Continue to column mapping →'.

The column mapping screen appears showing a table with a row whose source column is 'Order ID' mapped to standard field 'order_id', and a row 'Revenue' mapped to 'revenue'. The required fields note lists order_id, date, customer, region and revenue.
The screener already pre-fills correct standard field suggestions for every known column — do not change them. Click the primary button 'Confirm mapping & continue →'.
A success message 'Combined dataset ready: 4 rows across 1 file(s).' appears and the Processing page opens.
On the Processing page click the primary button 'Run cleaning & validation' and wait for the results.
Metric cards appear including 'Rows combined' = 4, 'Duplicates removed' = 1, 'Rows flagged' = 1 and 'Clean rows for reporting' = 2. A warning mentions '1 rows were flagged'.
A 'Cleaning log' table appears with a row labeled 'Duplicates Removed'.
Click the primary button 'View summary report →'.
The Summary report page shows a heading 'Summary table', a chart, and a total caption of the form 'Total: ... across 2 group(s) from 2 clean rows.'
